steps: Download the free Pampers Rewards app (Android or iPhone) and create an account.
Buy Pampers diapers or wipes and find the QR code inside the pack (diaper packs have a sticker; wipes have it printed).
Scan the code in the app — each scan adds Pampers Cash (added within 24 hours).
For every 10 diaper scans you receive $10 Pampers Cash (most boxes have 2 scans).
Redeem Pampers Cash in the app's rewards catalog for discounts/offers on Pampers at your favorite retailers.
timing: Official: Pampers Cash added within 24 hours; expires 6 months after being added.
